items.title: Sitecore Zero-Day Sparks New Round of ViewState Threats
items.description: The vulnerability marks the latest example of threat actors weaponizing exposed ASP.NET machine keys for remote injection and deserialization attacks.

items.title: Bridgestone Americas Confirms Cyberattack
items.description: Reports of disruptions at North American plants emerged earlier this week, though the nature of the attack on the tire manufacturer remains unclear.

items.title: Chinese Hackers Game Google to Boost Gambling Sites
items.description: New threat actor "GhostRedirector" is using a malicious IIS module to inject links that try to artificially boost search engine ranking for target sites.

items.title: ISC2 Aims to Bridge DFIR Skill Gap with New Certificate
items.description: The Nonprofit organization launched the Threat Handling Foundations Certificate amid mounting incident and breach disclosures.

items.title: ZDI-CAN-28071: Adobe
items.description: A CVSS score 7.8 AV:L/AC:L/PR:N/UI:R/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H severity vulnerability discovered by 'Michael DePlante (@izobashi) of Trend Zero Day Initiative' was reported to the affected vendor on: 2025-09-04, 0 days ago. The vendor is given until 2026-01-02 to publish a fix or workaround. Once the vendor has created and tested a patch we will coordinate the release of a public advisory.
